cursor.workflow: skill@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> [PROVEME] -> WATCHME(<probe>) -> PROVED
cursor.build_gate: clean — 30 teeth green twice under python3, sealed through persist_validation under the network seal (seal=sealed)
cursor.exit_gate: REFUSED for want of a probe: no probes/ directory is declared, so WATCHME has nothing to enter with. The boat rests at PROVEME. Same standing red as /idea, and the same cause — both doors were built ahead of the watch that would tell us they are working.
cursor.note: 30 teeth, every root injected, green on two consecutive runs, then sealed under the network seal (skills/design/validations/test_design_door.json). The sharpest tooth is THE CORPSE: a berth that exists, reads cleanly, and came from the right door, but exited routed_out. A naive implementation passes it — it is present and well-formed — and designing on it spends the resolver on a node the cheapest gate in the system already turned away, which is the waste Law 1 names.
cursor.documented: RETROACTIVE. Journaled 2026-08-04 after the build, under Akien's ruling that same day: "you can document it and still capture the intention and why and so on, it's only forgery if it's not approved as documentation." That message is the approval. The `at` stamps are the true times, read from git (commit 5059794), not the clock at write time — a documented voyage that lies about when it happened is the forgery the ruling excludes.
